marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light tonight and Friday. Showers changing to rain this evening then to flurries this
evening. Snow overnight changing to rain Friday morning and ending Friday
afternoon. Fog patches forming Friday afternoon. Low tonight minus 2. High Friday plus 3. <br/>
